g.text: What SkyPilot does once the nodes are up

g.font-family: 'Instrument Sans', Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Each step is tried up to 6 times and SSH waits up to 10 minutes; a step that still fails ends the launch.

g.text: Once the instances run, SkyPilot waits for SSH on every node, which Kubernetes and Slurm skip, and starts the Docker container when the task names an image.

g.font-family: 'Instrument Sans', Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: It copies the cloud credentials and its wheel to every node and runs the setup commands there, then starts Ray on the head and the workers and skylet on the head.

g.font-family: 'Instrument Sans', Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Success records the cluster as UP and marks it ever up; a step that still fails ends the launch with no failover, and the cluster stays INIT.
